brief: The canvas depicts whimsical, paper-cut ships traversing a translucent sheet, subjected to the passage of time and water. The scene displays the gentle patina and subtle graining of aged materials, overlaid with patches of visible moss and barnacle buildup. As the ships glide, they create ephemeral wake trails, which dissolve to leave behind permanent mineral streaks or crystalline salt deposits on the surrounding medium. This water damage causes the delicate paper edges to warp, tear, and finally detach into small, drifting fragments that accumulate into natural-looking piles along the sheet, constantly changing the topography of the surface.

lineage.critique: the same translucent sheet, and this time the dissolved wake trails leave behind permanent, dense trails of accumulated, crystalline sediment.

statement: This sketch depicts a whimsical underwater scene where paper-cut ships glide through a translucent, aged water surface. The ships leave behind dense, crystalline sediment trails that accumulate and form permanent deposits on the medium, contrasting with the ephemeral nature of their wake. The environment shows signs of weathering and growth—patches of moss and barnacles, warping edges, and tearing paper fragments that drift and pile up over time. The gentle motion of ships and particles creates an evolving landscape that captures both the fragility and endurance of materials subjected to the passage of time and water.
